_instructions: Score each render below by tagging every observed failure. Use the categories defined in the plan: Type (Invention/Omission/Displacement/Transformation/StyleDrift), Location (FrameEdge/Distant/Repetitive/Ambiguous/CoreMass), Severity (Critical/High/Medium/Low). Then subjectively score Photorealism, Material believability, and Lighting coherence on 1-10. The 'critical_failures' field is what gates a renderer in/out of consideration.

_severity_definitions.Critical: Changes building footprint, story count, window grid — architect rejects
_severity_definitions.High: Proportions, mullion patterns, or other visible geometric deviation
_severity_definitions.Medium: Material/glass tint/color choices — meant to change
_severity_definitions.Low: Shadows, sky, foreground vegetation — not part of design

nb_seed_300.notes: Best seed by a wide margin — no critical failures, photorealism 7/10. Blank right wall is preserved. Mullion grid deviation is High not Critical. This seed shows geometry hallucination is stochastic, not a hard model limit.

deterministic_failures: Blank-wall window invention (right facade): present in ALL 4 seeds at Critical or High severity — the model persistently hallucinates openings on solid walls. This is the primary architect-blocker.
Low photorealism (3/10): seeds 42, 100, 200 all score 3/10. Seed 300 is 7/10. Material quality also low across seeds 42, 100, 200.
stochastic_failures: Corner wraparound transformation: Critical in seeds 42 and 200, absent in seeds 100 and 300 — seed-dependent.
Omission of existing openings: seeds 42 and 200 only.
Severity of invention: seed 300 invents mullion patterns (High) but not blank-wall windows (Critical) — hallucination magnitude is stochastic and seed 300 is a meaningful outlier.
_summary.verdict_rationale: Seed 300 proves the model CAN preserve the blank right facade — it’s not a hard capability limit. Run B2 (tightened prompt: explicit zero-window constraint on right facade, no corner extension, pin mullion counts) before spending on other APIs. If B2 with seed 300 or a new seed produces zero critical failures, advance to Spike 3. If B2 fails across all seeds, escalate to B3 bake-off (FLUX Canny Pro is the strongest candidate for geometry-hard cases).
